variants.title: 法师A · 月庭礼装
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original full-body pixel-art character design cutout for a Godot fantasy RPG CHARACTER APPEARANCE REVIEW, NOT a production animation sheet.
Primary request: Design a gorgeous clearly ADULT fantasy hero in meticulous 16-BIT FANTASY / TACTICAL JRPG pixel art. Use attached character charts ONLY for the craftsmanship of panel 02 "16-BIT FANTASY" and panel 08 "TACTICAL RPG", and use the project concept only for original costume/color identity. Do not copy any chart character or output chart layouts.
Output: transparent PNG, portrait aspect about 2:3. Only ONE full-body character, one pose, no alternate poses, no miniature duplicate, no head inset, no panels, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, NO background or floor or fog. True transparent negative space including under the boots and between limbs/weapons; no checkerboard baked into the image, no white/colored border or halo. Keep the complete head/hair/hat/feet/weapon safely inside frame with modest even transparent margins; character should occupy most of the usable height.
Quality: Beautiful readable face with distinct eyes and expression, carefully separated hair locks, layered functional costume, material differences in fabric/leather/metal, purposeful controlled highlights and hue-shifted shadows. Crisp stepped contours, coherent square pixel CLUSTERS, selective colored outlines, confident limited color ramps. Make it real crafted pixel art, not smooth anime illustration, not airbrush or 3D, not tiny simplified 8-bit figures, not a painting with a mosaic filter. Avoid noisy one-pixel confetti and excessive filigree.
Proportions and pose: stylized adult tactical game proportions, roughly 4 to 4.5 heads tall rather than fashion-model elongation, graceful capable posture. Same calm grounded three-quarter view facing RIGHT for all variants, both boots resting on a clear horizontal baseline, slightly separated legs, face visible, hands anatomically clear and gripping the weapon correctly. Main weapon and hands have clean negative space from hair and cape so the silhouette can later be redrawn as a dedicated battle sprite. Modest practical layered clothing and armor, no sexualized pose or revealing armor.
This is a character appearance proposal only. Final character gender and design are not locked; no claim of an existing game mechanic. All generated characters are original.
Reference image 3 is our project's original moonwitch concept, used for mood and costume language only; images 1 and 2 are style charts. Create the FIRST outfit option for the SAME adult woman mage used across our three mage concepts: expressive amber eyes, beautiful heart-shaped face, rich plum-purple hair in separated long flowing locks, warm composed confidence. Palette shared across mage variants: midnight indigo, plum, ivory, muted antique gold, tiny sapphire accents.
OPTION MA - LUNAR CEREMONIAL OUTFIT. Elegant broad crescent witch hat, a small gold clasp, ivory blouse, short layered indigo-plum mantle and fitted bodice, practical layered knee-length asymmetric skirt over opaque dark leggings, refined leather gloves and knee boots. A slender crescent staff in one hand held diagonally beside the body, showing the whole shaft and tip, with clean silhouette away from the hat; other hand relaxed near a small element prism, no giant spell effect. The emotional focus is the face and grouped hair. Classic refined 16-bit fantasy witch feeling, tasteful controlled ornament. Keep abdomen, thighs and chest covered. No backpack, no extra pet. Roughly 4.25-head adult tactical proportions; expressive face and rich costume definition remain legible rather than excessively slim long legs.
